definitions.explanation: The decoration and furnishing of the inside of a room or building. In Japanese, used broadly to refer to furniture, decor items, and the overall design of indoor spaces.

examples.japanese: インテリア⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: To be particular about interior design.

examples.japanese: ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧なインテリア⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I went into a shop with stylish interior decor.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧インテリア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{変|か}えよう→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking of changing all the furnishings in my room when I move.

notes:
From English "interior." In Japanese, this word is used more broadly than in English — it can refer to the design concept, the furniture itself, and decorative items. Often used in compound forms and as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- インテリア⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧: interior design/furnishing store
- インテリアコーディネーター: interior coordinator/designer
- インテリア⟦{雑貨|ざっか}→雑貨：10008_zakka⟧: interior accessories/small decor items
- インテリアデザイン: interior design
- ⟦{北欧|ほくおう}→北欧：10139_hokuou⟧インテリア: Scandinavian-style interior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧: interior finish — more technical, refers to walls, floors, and built-in elements
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: furniture — the physical objects
- {調度品|ちょうどひん}: furnishings — formal term for furniture and fittings
- エクステリア: exterior — the opposite: outdoor design and landscaping
